text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Tuesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Negotiations between Lithuania and Latvia over a disputed area in the Baltic sea will continue on May 23.
- The construction of Butinge Oil Terminal will be finished by October 1998, company oficials said.
- Mazeikiu Nafta refined 477,000 tonnes of crude oil in April and posted a 5.9 million litas net profit.

- Lithuania's President Algirdas Brazauskas visited the Vistytis lake region to speed up the demarcation of the Lithuanian- Russian border, seen as the main obstacle to a meeting between Brazauskas and Russian President Boris Yeltsin.
- The fourth theatre festival LIFE has been stung with crticism and may be the last.
- The Centre Union said that they will name their candidate for December's presidential race on June 7.
- Lithuanian analysts say that Latvia's public concerns about the enviromental safety of the Butinge oil terminal are motivated by a desire to sheild Latvia's Ventspilis terminal from competition.
- Lithuanian enviroment experts claim that Butinge oil terminal is of no threat to the environment.
